Skip the boring manual input. BitePal scans your food from a photo and instantly shows a clear nutrition score, key highlights, and simple guidance. Just snap, check, and go — tracking your meals has never been faster.

TRACK CALORIES, WATER AND FASTING
- Stay on top of your goals with a clean, friendly dashboard 
- See your calories, nutrients, and weight progress 
- Keep your water intake steady
- Follow your fasting windows with gentle reminders

HAVE FUN AND DRESS UP YOUR RACCOON
Healthy eating feels easier when it’s playful. 
Personalize your raccoon with outfits, accessories, and seasonal looks that match your vibe. They react to your food choices with humor, attitude, and encouragement — making you actually want to keep up good habits.

IMPROVE YOUR DIET

name: DayClass
description:
Guided workout plans for your goals — joint-friendly and made for daily life. DayClass gives you a coach-led plan of short daily workouts, so you build strength, balance, and mobility. No equipment. No gym. No pressure.

Workout plans that fit your life
A clear, finite plan — not an endless feed. Start with a short Welcome Session, then follow one workout a day, with Rest Days built in. Miss a day? No catch-up guilt — pick up right where you are.

Guided step by step
Low-impact, easy-to-follow workouts you can do at home. Your coach sets the focus, then guides you through every move. Choose your intensity, from Gentle to Intense, and use a chair for steadier balance whenever you like.

Nutrition, tracked alongside
Log meals and follow daily calorie and macro targets right beside your workouts — so the whole day works toward your goal, not just the session.

A coach and a group that show up
Real members moving alongside you, and a coach who answers your questions right in the chat. A quiet, encouraging group — never a leaderboard. Send a clap to anyone working out with you.

Why it works
Movement only sticks when it feels possible. Workouts are kind to knees, backs, and joints — even when other routines aren't — and they build balance, mobility, and everyday energy. DayClass doesn't ask you to transform overnight. One day at a time, the plan becomes a habit that's actually yours.

Made for you if you're
— Building or rebuilding a daily movement habit

name: Brick - Ditch Distractions
description:
Brick is the world's first digital wellness tool designed to turn smartphones back into tools, helping people take back control of their time, attention, and technology. A small tool paired with a powerful app that temporarily removes distracting apps and their notifications from your iPhone, leaving only what you choose.

In a world designed for constant distraction, Brick introduces a simple but powerful idea: friction. By requiring a physical tap to enable or disable distracting apps, Brick creates a deliberate pause between impulse and action - turning smartphones back into tools for what matters. 

HOW IT WORKS
Choose which apps or websites to block: social media, games, news, streaming, or anything distracting
Tap your iPhone to Brick to activate your chosen mode
A focus timer starts automatically, tracking your distraction-free time
Place Brick somewhere out of reach and go live your life
When you're ready, tap again to regain access 

Not nearby? Activate Brick remotely in the app. You'll still need the physical Brick to unblock, keeping the commitment real.

FEATURES
Block any iPhone app (except the dialer, per Apple policy) and select Safari websites
Create custom modes for different parts of your day: Work, Family, Sleep, Gym, Study, Focus, and more
A built-in focus timer tracks how long you stay undistracted
Strict Mode closes loopholes, preventing workarounds while you're in a session
5 Emergency Unbricks included for unexpected situations
Usage history tracks yo
